title: THE CARD IN THE DRAWER · The lamp on 101
venue: the motel · a card left in room twelve's nightstand each month by a guest never seen · Box 12
logline: The first card, found in room twelve's nightstand the second week of the job: not a printed card — a drawn one, in a hand that isn't his, of an old man with a lantern on a road. He redraws it that night as the thing it is in Small Wood: a man carrying a green desk lamp along 101 with the cord over his shoulder. The card's name is the thing. The guest who left it: never seen.

panels.composition: A single tall card filling the page, its border drawn as the wooden edge of a motel nightstand drawer; inside the border: a thin man from behind walking the shoulder of a coastal highway carrying a green swing-arm desk lamp by its arm with the cord over his shoulder, the sea gray beside him. No numeral, no title; the card's name is the thing.
